modalLead: The Service overview puts a service on one screen, the Timeline shows why it went down, and a Timer widget joins the dashboard.

items.title: One screen for each service
items.text: One screen for each service. The Service overview shows a service's status, uptime, container and a timeline of what happened. Press l on a bookmark, type :service, or choose Service overview in a panel.

media.alt: The Service overview of Sonarr: All good, 30-day uptime, response time, the container with its image and version, and a timeline with an update, an outage of 14 minutes and a new release

items.title: A timeline with a likely cause
items.text: A timeline with a likely cause. Config, Timeline lists container events, updates, outages, Glances incidents and Unraid alerts in one stream. An outage shows what came shortly before it, such as an update of the same container.

media.alt: Config, Timeline: an outage of Sonarr for 14 minutes, with the line Likely cause, 1 min after sonarr auto-updated 4.0.9 to 4.0.10

items.text: Outages reach the bell at once. The bell rings as soon as a check finishes. The tab title starts with a red dot and the number, and an installed app shows it on its icon.
Certificate warnings only when expired. Short-lived certificates renew themselves, so Warn about certificates also offers Only when expired, and a bookmark can set its own rule for its host.
A domain date by hand. For a domain whose registry publishes no date, type it in the bookmark's Expectations panel and nextDash warns like it does for any other.
TLS checks on mail and FTP ports. A TLS check on a port such as 25, 587, 143 or 21 now asks for STARTTLS first, so these servers no longer fail with a handshake error.

items.title: A kitchen timer and a pomodoro
items.text: A kitchen timer and a pomodoro. The Timer widget counts down in the browser. It rings when time is up, puts a ⏰ in the tab title and keeps a row in the bell until you stop it.

media.alt: A Timer tile: a ring around 01:00, four presets, a box for your own and a Start button

items.title: Act from a tile
items.text: Act from a tile. Approve or decline a Seerr request, start a search in Sonarr or Radarr, pause a download in qBittorrent or SABnzbd, or pause blocking in Pi-hole and AdGuard Home without leaving the dashboard. Turn it on in the widget's settings.
Labels between bookmarks. Right-click a category header and choose Add label to split a long category into groups, or choose Add label above on a bookmark.
A typo in a command still finds it. Type :dokcer and the palette offers :docker.
Saving colours keeps the Classic group. A colours save used to empty the Classic chip in the theme picker for good.
